purpose: Teach: 野蛮/因縁/壮絶/和声/手話/威嚇/平常/直視

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、野蛮な商慣行を排除しろ
lines.en: Eliminate savage business practices from this company.
lines.style: Clipped, authoritative opening. Each word lands with precision. No wasted breath. The tone of someone accustomed to being obeyed without explanation.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。競合との因縁を清算します
lines.en: Yes. I'll settle accounts with our competitors.
lines.style: Measured acknowledgment. Slight pause after 'yes' before committing to action. Steady, earnest. The cadence of someone accepting responsibility they take seriously.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 壮絶な労働環境にしないよう監督しろ
lines.en: Oversee that we don't create a brutal work environment.
lines.style: Direct instruction, no room for interpretation. Brief pause mid-sentence for emphasis. Calm authority. The voice of someone who has seen what happens when standards slip.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員の声の和声的調和を目指します
lines.en: Yes. We'll work toward genuine harmony in staff voices.
lines.style: Formal affirmation. Slight lift on 'harmony' — the aspirational word. Steady pace, careful. The tone of someone repeating a principle back to confirm understanding.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、手話通訳の研修を導入しろ
lines.en: Introduce sign language interpreter training at this company.
lines.style: Clear directive, stated as fact rather than request. Slight weight on 'introduce' — this is non-negotiable. No room for hesitation or debate in the delivery.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社内の威嚇的言動は処分対象です
lines.en: Yes. Threatening behavior and language will result in disciplinary action.
lines.style: Firm, precise. The word 'disciplinary' carries its full weight without being emphasized. Unwavering. The assurance of someone stating established policy.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、平常時から危機管理を徹底しろ
lines.en: Maintain rigorous crisis management even during stable times.
lines.style: Grave, unhurried. Each phrase carries equal weight. No urgency in the delivery, but absolute certainty in the message. The wisdom of someone who understands prevention.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。経営課題を直視する姿勢を貫きます
lines.en: Yes. We'll maintain the posture of facing management challenges directly.
lines.style: Closing confirmation. Slight deepening of tone on 'directly' — a promise beneath the formality. Steady to the end. The final word carries resolve and commitment.
